functions.name: HISTORY
functions.description: Time-aligned history for one or more tags. With a start, the first row is the start itself carrying each tag's last known value; with an interval, each slice is aggregated with avg as a time-weighted average. Values whose latest point is not Good quality show red.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: Dataset name.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: One tag name, a range of tag names, or an array such as {"a","b"}.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Window start: an Excel date, an ISO timestamp, or a relative expression like "-24h". Blank means just now.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Window end. Blank means now.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Slice width such as "30s", "5m", "1h". Blank means every raw sample, carried forward from the start.

parameters.name: aggregate
parameters.description: avg = time-weighted average (also "twa"); or min, max, first, last, count, sum, range. Only used with interval. Defaults to avg. Each slice starts from the value held at its start.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: any, good, or notbad. Defaults to any.

parameters.name: lookback
parameters.description: How far before start to look for the carried-in value if the Historian's prior-value point is missing or rejected. Defaults to "7d".

parameters.name: novalue
parameters.description: Points with no value (quality notes such as 64): "flag" (default) keeps the row, carries the last value through it and shows it red; "drop" leaves those rows out.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Extra columns after each tag: any of "quality" (worst OPC quality code in the row's range), "status" (the same in words), "samples" (points logged), "good%" (share that were Good). E.g. "quality,samples,good%".

functions.name: SAMPLE
functions.description: Sample-and-hold for state tags: one row per clock-aligned boundary (07:00, 07:05, ...), each the last raw value at or before it. A state shorter than the interval can fall between rows and not appear. Values whose latest point is not Good quality show red.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: Dataset name.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: One tag name, a range of tag names, or an array such as {"a","b"}.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Window start: an Excel date, an ISO timestamp, or a relative expression like "-24h".

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Window end, inclusive. Blank means now.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Minutes between rows (5), or text with a unit ("30s", "15m", "1h", "1d"). Defaults to 5.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: "last": sample-and-hold. Defaults to last.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: good (default), notbad, or any. Rejected samples are skipped and the previous value holds.

parameters.name: integers
parameters.description: TRUE (default) truncates numbers to integers, so 6.0 reads as 6. FALSE keeps the stored type.

parameters.name: lookback
parameters.description: How far before start to search for a seed value if the Historian's prior-value point is missing or rejected. Defaults to "7d".

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Extra columns after each tag: any of "quality" (worst OPC quality code in the row's range), "status" (the same in words), "samples" (points logged), "good%" (share that were Good). E.g. "quality,samples,good%".

functions.name: VALUE
functions.description: The current (or last known) value of a single Historian tag.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: Dataset name.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tag name.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: "raw" (default) returns the stored number or string. "display" resolves units and enum labels.

functions.name: DATASETS
functions.description: List the datasets on this Historian, with tag count, size and data age.

functions.name: TAGS
functions.description: Search tags in a dataset. Supports the Historian filter language: name:, description:, datatype:, type:, format:, AND/OR/NOT, and wildcards.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: Dataset name.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Filter query, e.g. "name:Pump_* AND datatype:Double". Blank returns every tag.
